title: urachne mutica
intro: Urachne mutica, commonly known as the Needle Grass or Needle Bush, is a plant species native to tropical Africa. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Urachne mutica include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system and reduce oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Urachne mutica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
